pages.text: $(o)Tall, quiet folk from the End.$()$(br2)$(l)Gifts$()$(li)+20% Arcane spell power.$(li)Endermen do not mind your gaze.$(li)Void Pocket: 9 slots of your own, kept when you die.

$(l)Abilities$()$(li)$(k:key.neoorigins.skill_1): Blink (30 s): teleport up to 12 blocks to where you look.$(li)$(k:key.neoorigins.skill_2): Void Surge (20 s): a firework-like boost while gliding with an elytra.$(li)$(k:key.neoorigins.skill_3): Void Pocket: open your pocket.$(br2)$(l)Drawbacks$()$(li)Water hurts you (rain does not).
